raw_segments.text: Town folk we are father town folk yet. We are peasants though. We live in the town
I have come to see you Oh father. We heard of you father. We heard of you
I have buried my little son and I have come on a pilgrimage
I have been in three monasteries, but they told me go nastasia go to them. That is to you
I have come I was yesterday at the service and today I have come to you
